title: Wildflower Bouquet Cotton Beanie, Botanical Floral Beanie, Cottagecore Winter Hat, Flower Lover Gift for Her
description:
A little bouquet of chamomile, lavender and a coral poppy tied with a ribbon, printed on a soft 100% cotton beanie. Delicate, botanical and cosy.

DETAILS
- 100% cotton knit beanie, soft and breathable
- Small printed design on the front
- One size fits most adults
- Colours: Black, Navy, Graphite

CARE
Hand wash cold, inside out, lay flat to dry. Do not iron the print.

PRODUCTION AND SHIPPING
Printed on demand by our production partner in the USA and shipped with tracking. Production takes 2-5 business days. Free shipping within the USA; this item ships to the USA and Canada only.

Design created by MurettoStudio with the help of AI image tools, then checked and prepared for print by me.

Photos: the first photo is the product mockup from our print partner; the lifestyle photos are digital mockups created for illustration.
